name: Kayode Chat Lead Capture
author: damilolakayode

sections.description:
Kayode Chat Lead Capture is a professional marketing tool designed to help business owners stop losing potential customers. While standard click-to-chat buttons send users away from your site instantly, this plugin acts as a lead-generation gatekeeper.

How it works

When a visitor clicks the floating WhatsApp button, a professional modal appears asking for their Name, Email, and Message. Once submitted, the data is saved locally to your WordPress database. The plugin then automatically pre-fills the visitor’s message into WhatsApp and redirects them to the chat.

Features

  • Lead Capture: Save contact details to a custom database table.
  • Smart Pre-fill: Automatically types the customer’s message into WhatsApp.
  • Analytics: View total clicks and leads captured in your dashboard.
  • GDPR Ready: Includes a mandatory consent checkbox for privacy compliance.
  • CSV Export: Download your leads list for email marketing.

External services

This plugin relies on the official WhatsApp API to facilitate communication between the website visitor and the site owner.

  • Service: WhatsApp Public API
  • Usage: Redirects the user to a WhatsApp chat window with a pre-filled message.
  • Data sent: The visitor’s name and the message they typed in the lead form are passed as URL parameters to the WhatsApp API.
  • Service Link: https://api.whatsapp.com
  • Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kayode-chat-lead-capture folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Kayode Chat’ menu in your sidebar to configure your settings.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fixed analytics counter displaying blank when there are no clicks.
  • Other minor improvements and bug fixes.
